node.title: KoalaBear aligned-positive literal-cell crosswalk
node.closure: exact source/target semantic crosswalk plus a generic covariance route fence
node.statement: The local fixed-moving and moving-moving source reconstructions are literally the F00={E01,E02} and M00={E02,E03} assignments. Evaluating the local residual proportionality equations at the roots of q=(T-c)(T-d) proves same=R20, swap=R02, and mixed=R11. Thus the six local systems are {F00,M00} x {R02,R11,R20}. A generic endpoint normalization commuting with inversion changes the target roots when W is fixed, so matching-centralizer transitivity does not transport these proofs to the other literal source assignments.
